children: Denmark-based online review platform's H1 revenue rose 23% yr/yr to $151 mln
Adjusted diluted EPS for H1 rose 44% yr/yr to 3.1 cents
Net loss for H1 was $1.1 mln, impacted by non-recurring regulatory and tax items
Trustpilot maintains outlook for high-teens constant currency revenue growth for FY26
Company expects 2-3ppt YoY adjusted EBITDA margin increase for FY26
Trustpilot says it remains confident in delivering sustainable growth and operating leverage over the long term
ENTERPRISE AND US SALES - Co said strong enterprise growth and US momentum drove bookings and revenue higher
AI ADOPTION - Co said increased use of Trustpilot reviews by AI engines boosted platform visibility and business demand
PRODUCT INNOVATION - Co said new Product Review Pages and expanded Shopify partnership increased citations and customer engagement
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 11 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the online services peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Trustpilot Group PLC is GBp332.00, about 26.8% above its September 14 closing price of GBp261.80
The stock recently traded at 41 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 42 three months ago
